name: job-search
title: Job Search
summary: A job search on a Slipdock board: a daily scan scores postings against your own criteria and analyses the gaps, and documents are built when you ask.
author: Slipdock

requires.connector: the Slipdock connector (MCP), or the slipdock CLI with a token
requires.for_scanning: for signed-in sources, a browser the agent can drive, signed in to them
requires.for_documents: pandoc and LibreOffice where generate runs (Claude's cloud has both), and python3
